surah.personality_title: Al-Wāqiʿah — The Inescapable Sifting of Human Destiny
surah.personality_summary: Sobering, analytical, sensory, and definitive. Al-Wāqiʿah presents the inevitable Event that lowers and exalts, classifying humanity into three eternal cohorts: the Foremost (Al-Sābiqūn), the People of the Right, and the People of the Left. It interrogates human self-sufficiency through basic life supports (semen, agriculture, water, and fire) before swearing by the setting of stars to the transcendent preservation of the Noble Qur'an.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Opens with the shaking of the earth and falling of the Event, and concludes commanding glorification of the Supreme Name of the Lord (Fa-sabbiḥ bi-ismi rabbika al-'Aẓīm, 56:96).
surah.overview: Surah Al-Waaqia (The Inevitable) is the 56th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 96 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا وقعت الواقعة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the Occurrence occurs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When that which is coming arrives

ayahs.translation_saheeh: There is, at its occurrence, no denial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: no one will be able to deny it has come

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: bringing low and raising high

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the earth is shaken violently

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the mountains are ground to powder

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And become dust dispersing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and turn to scattered dust

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you become [of] three kinds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then you will be sorted into three classes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those on the Right––what people they are

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those on the Left––what people they are

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the forerunners, the forerunners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And those in front––ahead indeed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In the Gardens of Pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in Gardens of Bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A [large] company of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: many from the past

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And a few of the later peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and a few from later generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On thrones woven [with ornament]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On couches of well-woven cloth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Reclining on them, facing each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will sit facing each other

ayahs.translation_saheeh: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: everlasting youths will go round among them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that causes no headache or intoxication

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fruit of what they select
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [there will be] any fruit they choose

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the meat of any bird they like

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and beautiful companions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The likenesses of pearls well-protected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: like hidden pearls

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As reward for what they used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a reward for what they used to do

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تاثيما
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا قِيلࣰ ا سَلَٰمࣰ ا سَلَٰمࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Only a saying: "Peace, peace
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: only clean and wholesome speech

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those on the Right, what people they are

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and clustered acacia

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And shade extended
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with spreading shade

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And water poured out
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: constantly flowing water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fruit, abundant [and varied]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: abundant fruits

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: unfailing, unforbidden

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [upon] beds raised high
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with incomparable companions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have specially created––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made them virgins
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: virginal

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: loving, of matching age––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the companions of the right [who are]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for those on the Right

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A company of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: many from the past

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And a company of the later peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and many from later generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But those on the Left, what people they are

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And a shade of black smoke
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in the shadow of black smoke

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Neither cool nor beneficial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: neither cool nor refreshing

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Before, they overindulged in luxury

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they used to persist in the great violation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and persisted in great sin

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكانوا يقولون ائذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما اانا لمبعوثون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And our forefathers [as well]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And our earliest forefathers too?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘The earliest and latest generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And filling with it your bellies
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: filling your bellies with it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and drink scalding water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: lapping it like thirsty camels.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have created you, so why do you not believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It was We who created you: will you not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have you seen that which you emit
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Consider [the semen] you eject

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنْشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: على ان نبدل امثالكم وننشئكم في ما لا تعلمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد علمتم النشاة الاولى فلولا تذكرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: is it you who make them grow or We

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمࣰ ا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لو نشاء لجعلناه حطاما فظلتم تفكهون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘We are burdened with debt

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, we have been deprived
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we are bereft.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And have you seen the water that you drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Consider the water you drink

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَأَنْتُمْ أَنْزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنْزِلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اانتم انزلتموه من المزن ام نحن المنزلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجࣰ ا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَوْ نَشَاءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لو نشاء جعلناه اجاجا فلولا تشكرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And have you seen the fire that you ignite
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Consider the fire you kindle

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَأَنْتُمْ أَنْشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنْشِئُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اانتم انشاتم شجرتها ام نحن المنشئون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَمَتَٰعࣰ ا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then I swear by the setting of the stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I swear by the positions of the stars

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a mighty oath, if you only knew

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that this is truly a noble Quran

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In a Register well-protected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in a protected Record

ayahs.translation_saheeh: None touch it except the purified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that only the purified can touch

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: sent down from the Lord of all being

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can you scorn this statement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you are at that time looking on
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: while you gaze on

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْكُمْ وَلَٰكِنْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونحن اقرب اليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: why, if you are not to be judged

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Bring it back, if you should be truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما ان كان من اصحاب اليمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if he was of the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: if he is one of those on the Right

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّالِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما ان كان من المكذبين الضالين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he will be welcomed with scalding water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And burning in Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He will burn in Hell

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this is the true certainty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is the certain truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme
